name: Select
purpose: Choosing one value from a short, known list. Native element underneath.
notFor: Async or very long option lists

options.angular: input.required<BhSelectOption[]>() — data, not projected content: only <option> and <optgroup> are valid children of a native <select>, and Angular’s projection wrapper is neither

placeholder.note: Rendered as a disabled first option.

aria.labelling: From the associated <label>, which is required. There is no aria-label prop: a select whose name lives in an attribute is a select nobody can point voice control at (WCAG 2.5.3).
aria.focus: Ring on the wrapper, driven from :focus-visible on the native select via a sibling selector, so it cannot desynchronise from real focus.
aria.announcements: None. The native select announces its own expanded state and option count; a live region on top of that double-announces. An error is read from aria-describedby on focus, not announced when it appears.
